hook: The 2006 shopping centre built behind the Emporium's 1896 facade and glass dome.

building.name: Westfield San Francisco Centre
building.architect: Kohn Pedersen Fox (Kevin Kennon, design principal), 2006 redevelopment; Albert Pissis, original 1897 Emporium building

historic_status.reason: Article 11 Individual, Article 11 Conservation District, Historic Survey Result

historic_survey.note: The survey files 845 Market Street under APN 3705050, which is the parcel this page describes; EAS assigns the street number to the neighbouring 3705049. The survey dates the building 1896 and 1908, against the assessor's 2006 for the rebuilt centre behind the retained Emporium facade.

public_open_space.name: Westfield Sky Terrace (Wesfield Center Mall)
public_open_space.location: Roof top, 9th floor. Accessible by elevator in 835 Market St (only 1st elevator goes to 9th floor).
public_open_space.description: This extensive 9th floor rooftop space looks onto the dome of the mall and has views westward and sunlight. It does not have direct food service, but food may be found in the food court below in the mall.
public_open_space.landscaping: Wall planters and 15 basic planters. Great views.
public_open_space.seating: 32 tables, 47 movable chairs, 11 movable cushioned chairs, 15 cushioned bench seats
public_open_space.food_service: None, but food on the premises

sections.heading: The Emporium
sections.body: Albert Pissis's Emporium department store opened on this site in 1896, burned in 1906, and was rebuilt by 1908. Forest City and Westfield's $440 million redevelopment kept the front facade and the domed glass roof, restoring the dome as the centre of the new complex, and reopened on 28 September 2006. The shopping centre closed on 24 January 2026.
